title_zh: 相亲真人秀：爱情的游戏
title_en: Chinese TV Dramas (17/20): Dating Reality Shows, the Game of Love
note_en: In "if ... then" sentences, Chinese puts 就 right before the verb of the result clause: 如果两位嘉宾互相有好感，他们就可以选择牵手离开 "if two guests like each other, they can choose to leave hand in hand." English often drops "then," but 就 is hard to leave out here, and it comes after the subject (他们就), not before it.
